dec.pe: In 1992 more than 25,000 long-term residents of Slovenia from other Yugoslav republics were wiped from the residence register and lost their jobs and rights. The Grand Chamber said Slovenia must compensate them.
dec.pi: Pada 1992 lebih dari 25.000 penduduk lama Slovenia dari republik Yugoslavia lain dihapus dari daftar penduduk dan kehilangan pekerjaan serta hak. Majelis Agung menyatakan Slovenia wajib memberi ganti rugi.
